chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Saif ibn Amirah from Ali ibn al-Mughira who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who enjoys the use of a woman's slave-girl without her permission. He said: There is no objection to it.

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no objection to it / it is permissible
key_terms.يَتَمَتَّعُ: enjoys the use of / derives benefit from

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a man to use a female slave owned by another woman without her permission?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Istibsar*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that a man may exercise *tamattu'* (sexual enjoyment) with a female slave owned by another woman without requiring her explicit permission, distinguishing this from the requirement of the owner's consent for the initial acquisition contract. This ruling underscores the distinct legal status of *ummahat al-awlad* (mothers of children) or general female slaves in Shia jurisprudence, where the owner's right is primary but not necessarily a barrier to the master's use. The hadith is cited in the chapter discussing whether the marriage contract (*'aqd*) on slaves requires the owner's permission, highlighting the nuance between ownership rights and usage rights.
